root_cause_identification.expected_solution: Agent must identify the Nomad-side leader/plan-applier path (nomad/leader.go::establishLeadership and nomad/plan_apply.go::planApply) AND the hashicorp/raft FSM goroutine (fsm.go::runFSM) plus the leader commit path (raft.go / commitment.go). The report must explain the asymmetry: raft reports entries committed (quorum-acked) before the FSM goroutine has applied them to nomad/state/state_store.go, and the plan applier starts running while the FSM backlog is still draining.
evaluation_criteria: Names nomad/leader.go and/or nomad/plan_apply.go on the Nomad side
Names hashicorp/raft fsm.go (runFSM) and/or raft.go / commitment.go as the consensus side
States that committed-index advances ahead of applied-index, so state_store reads lag the committed log

error_chain_trace.expected_solution: Agent must trace at least four hops: leader transition / establishLeadership -> raft commits backlog entries -> runFSM has not finished draining -> planApply queries stale state_store -> plan rejected (or stuck pending). The report must explicitly connect the leader-transition trigger to the apply/ack asymmetry.
evaluation_criteria: Mentions the leader transition (or leadership transfer / leader election) as the trigger
Mentions establishLeadership or the leader.go path
Mentions planApply or plan_apply.go (and that it rejects plans / sees stale state)
Mentions the raft FSM goroutine (runFSM / fsm.go) or applied-vs-committed index gap

affected_components.expected_solution: Agent must name the Nomad leader manager, the plan applier (or scheduler workers / state_store), and the hashicorp/raft library / FSM goroutine.
evaluation_criteria: Names Nomad leader manager (leader.go / establishLeadership) or scheduler workers
Names the plan applier or state_store (plan_apply.go / state_store.go / fsm.go on the Nomad side)
Names the hashicorp/raft library (runFSM, raft.go, commitment.go, or 'raft FSM goroutine')

remediation_proposal.expected_solution: Agent must propose at least one concrete remediation: (a) FSM drain barrier on leadership establish (apply a no-op and wait), (b) gate planApply on applied-index >= committed-index, OR (c) upstream raft contract change to expose applied-index notifications. The report must say where the fix lives.
evaluation_criteria: Proposes one of: barrier/drain on FSM, applied-index gating, or upstream raft contract change
Identifies where the fix would live (nomad/leader.go, nomad/plan_apply.go, or hashicorp/raft fsm.go)
